model.name: task.backfillLastAdvancedFromGit
model.description: One-time self-draining migration: populate lastAdvancedAt on existing S37 Task units from each unit's LAST status/checklist-CHANGING git commit (authoritative recency source), so the R40.18 max-lastAdvancedAt current-derivation has data for pre-seam tasks. A task with no status/checklist-changing commit reports UNRESOLVED (ranks-last, never faked). Report-only -> auto-strict-at-0 as the seam stamps new advances (self-draining debt). Reversible + content-conserving (deliberate metadata add, NOT INV-T byte-diff).
